Saved connections to this Mac's configured gateway now use the same startup and
upgrade path as "This Mac". When an older local gateway is running, the app safely
restarts it with the gateway bundled in the current app. Saved Cloud and external
gateways remain independently managed.

Chats load their full history into a virtualized transcript. A message rail lets
you preview and jump to earlier user messages, including history inherited from
forked chats. Inherited pages continue through ancestor chats automatically;
rail previews stay visible outside the scroller and messages have accessible labels.

Includes gateway 0.16.3 and protocol 88. Requires the matching Cloud deployment and
iOS 0.10.0 (417) for shared connections. The App Store 1.0.0 submission is separate.
